## What changed

**`src/middleware/request-id/request-id.ts`**
- `request-id.ts:16` — added `trustIncoming?: boolean` to `RequestIdOptions`.
- `request-id.ts:46` — destructured `trustIncoming = true` in the factory, so omitting the option preserves existing behavior.
- `request-id.ts:51` — incoming header is only read when trusted:
  ```ts
  let reqId = trustIncoming && headerName ? c.req.header(headerName) : undefined
  ```
  When `trustIncoming: false`, `reqId` stays `undefined` so the existing `if (!reqId || ...)` branch always calls `generator(c)`. Length/charset validation, `c.set('requestId', ...)`, and the `headerName`-guarded `c.header(...)` are untouched — so the generated value is still exposed via `c.get('requestId')` and the response header, and `headerName: ''` still suppresses the response header.
- `request-id.ts:26` — JSDoc `@param {boolean} [options.trustIncoming=true] - Whether to use the incoming request id header.`

**`src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts`** (4 new tests, existing tests untouched)
- `index.test.ts:170-194` — `trustIncoming: false`: incoming `X-Request-Id: hono-is-hot` is ignored (header + body match UUID v4); generated id also used when no header is sent.
- `index.test.ts:196-215` — `trustIncoming: false` + custom generator: incoming header present, header and `c.get('requestId')` both return `GeneratedByHono` from the generator.
- `index.test.ts:217-233` — `trustIncoming: true`: incoming `trusted-id` is echoed in header and body. Default-mode preservation is additionally covered by the pre-existing "Should return custom request id" test at `index.test.ts:20`, which passes no option.
